{{Top|leg}}
The '''talin''' was the largest social unit in the [[Jiivahar]] society. It consisted of five to ten families, although membership was fluid and was not constrained by familial lines. A talin had one or more leaders, selected on merit&mdash;wisdom or experience were the relevant qualifications.
